items.title: Alfred Williams Interview, 1961-10-13
items.q: We used to get our kick. Well, that composed of us... Eddie Pearson, DeJong... We started playing his bass. Boy, we'd fall out. Piron. Piron. Piron said, what the fuck?

ctx.x: It was supposed to be the band that led to Piron's band Who did he form his band out of when we were women?
No, no, it was a band that he took over, you know
